data.title: Journey Through Our Solar System
data.description: Explore the members of our solar system! Learn about the different types of worlds that travel around our Sun.

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.description: The Sun is our star! It's a giant ball of hot gas that gives us light and warmth.
bodies.funFact: The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Mercury is a rocky world covered in craters. It is part of the inner group of planets.
bodies.funFact: Mercury is super fast! It zips around the Sun in just 88 days.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Venus is a rocky planet covered in thick, cloudy layers. It is an inner planet.
bodies.funFact: A day on Venus (243 Earth days) is longer than its year (225 Earth days)!

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Earth is our rocky home planet! It has liquid water and a protective atmosphere.
bodies.funFact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god or goddess!

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Mars is a rocky planet with volcanoes and canyons. It is the last of the inner planets.
bodies.funFact: Mars looks red because its soil contains rusty iron!

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: Jupiter is a giant world made mostly of gas. It features spinning storm clouds and a famous red spot.
bodies.funFact: Jupiter has 95 moons and counting! Its moon Ganymede is bigger than Mercury.

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: Saturn is a gas giant surrounded by huge, beautiful rings made of ice and rock.
bodies.funFact: Saturn is so light it could float in water (if you had a bathtub big enough)!

bodies.name: Uranus
bodies.description: Uranus is an ice giant planet with a blue-green appearance caused by methane gas.
bodies.funFact: Uranus rolls around the Sun like a ball instead of spinning like a top!

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.description: Neptune is an icy giant world with deep blue layers and active weather patterns.
bodies.funFact: Neptune has the fastest winds in the solar system - up to 1,200 mph!

bodies.name: Pluto
bodies.description: Pluto is a small, icy world classified as a dwarf planet located in the outer regions.
bodies.funFact: Pluto has a heart-shaped glacier on its surface!

challenges.prompt: Rocky planets are the smaller ones made of rock. Say the name of one rocky planet.
Gas giants are the great big planets made of gas. Say the name of one gas giant.
A dwarf planet is a tiny world, smaller than a true planet. Say the name of one dwarf planet.
